beats.say: Datadog and Baseten fine-tuned a small open model on production LLM traces for the Patterns topic-clustering feature.
Read a sample, write your labels file, then record it pup finetune dataset sample datasets/my-agent --count 20 pup finetune dataset label datasets/my-agent --file datasets/labels.jsonl # 3.
The deployment scales between 0 and 1 replicas and bills per GPU-second while a replica runs, until you undeploy it. pup-finetune creates the directories 0700 and their files 0600.
